_note: Sweep batch 04: tier-1 passages 2026-07-24 to 2026-08-01. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He declares that over the next five months there will be a miraculous turnaround in marriages and in wayward and rebellious children, with glory manifesting in households and a significant change people can point to.
mentions.quote: out of the next five months, this will be a miraculous turnaround in marriages
mentions.falsify_match: A reported wave of restored marriages and returning children in his congregation by January 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such wave, though the claim has no shared measure.

mentions.claim_text: Light banter thanking God for summer ending and school starting, with an aside about homeschooling.
mentions.quote: School's about to start
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: seasonal small talk in prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He prays anointing oil over children heading back to school, declaring angels bear them up, that they are protected, have favour and will find godly friends.
mentions.quote: My kids are protected. They'll have favor
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a blessing over children with no shared criterion.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls saying back in January that an agreement was coming over Gaza and that when it happened they would build hotels and a golf course, and notes Jared Kushner surfaced a week or two later.
mentions.quote: I saw an agreement coming with the Gaza
mentions.falsify_match: A Gaza agreement followed by resort and golf course development plans.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing a Trump flag planted on Gaza and a beautiful golf course with hotels and buildings being made there, and dates the agreement vision to 9 or 30 January.
mentions.quote: I saw a a beautiful golf course being made with uh uh like hotels
mentions.falsify_match: Resort construction on Gaza land under American branding.

mentions.claim_text: He dates a word to 10 July in which he said they are going to make a deal, warns not to touch the Holy Land, and says another Katrina-scale disaster is coming.
mentions.quote: Another Katrina disaster is comin
mentions.falsify_match: A US disaster of Katrina scale, tied by him to a Holy Land deal.

mentions.claim_text: He says winning the midterms matters because the southern border in 2028 depends on it, and that if the Democrats win again they will flood the country.
mentions.quote: that's basically the southern border in 2028
mentions.falsify_match: A large rise in border crossings after Democratic gains.
mentions.falsify_miss: Crossings do not rise, or Democrats do not gain.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that Byron wins the Republican nomination by a landslide next week, and prays over three Senate seats that the other side is trying to flip blue in the battleground states.
mentions.quote: The three seats to flip blue. They're trying to flip blue
mentions.falsify_match: Byron wins the nomination in a landslide and the three named Senate seats hold.
mentions.falsify_miss: He loses, or the seats flip.

mentions.claim_text: He points to more than a hundred aftershocks in Japan after a deadly quake that killed thirteen and left old temples in rubble, and to reports of the biggest rise in antisemitism in the UK.
mentions.quote: more than a hundred aftershocks hit Japan after deadly quake
mentions.falsify_match: Old temple structures destroyed by quakes and record UK antisemitism figures.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither is borne out by the record.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls seeing Detroit and hearing the instruction to activate the mosque, with people asked to help interfere with the November election, and says he saw an uprising organised through mosques to cause chaos in the November vote.
mentions.quote: I saw Detroit and I heard activate the mosque
mentions.falsify_match: Documented organised interference in the November 2026 election run through mosques in Detroit.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that more than half of England is officially in drought and that Kamala Harris is preparing another presidential run in 2028 by rebranding herself, which he says is exactly what the Lord had said.
mentions.quote: She's going to rebrand herself just like the Lord said
mentions.falsify_match: Harris runs in 2028 on a visibly reworked platform and identity.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees acceleration, missiles flying, plots against the churches, plots against the elections, and plots involving North Korea and South Korea, and urges readiness because Jesus is coming soon.
mentions.quote: I see plots against our churches. I see plots against the elections
mentions.falsify_match: Foiled or executed plots against US churches and the election, plus a Korean crisis.

mentions.claim_text: He counts about seven weeks to the fall feast on 11 September and says birthing pains increase every time they hit these fall feasts, with acceleration through the rest of the summer.
mentions.quote: birthing pains increase every time we hit these fall f
mentions.time_phrase: seven weeks to the fall feast
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable step up in crisis events at the 2026 fall feasts.

mentions.claim_text: He plays news that the FAA issued a nationwide ground stop for all American Airlines flights over an IT issue, and says the Lord showed this on 25 June.
mentions.quote: Federal Aviation Administration has issued a nationwide ground stop
mentions.falsify_match: The 25 June clip describes an aviation IT outage before this one occurred.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip is vaguer than the event he matches it to.

mentions.claim_text: He notes American Airlines resumed flights just as he said, credits God with the accuracy, and says he does not want to be flaky about it.
mentions.quote: American Air resumes flights after it just like the Lord said
mentions.falsify_match: The prior word specified an aviation IT failure and a resumption.
mentions.falsify_miss: The resumption is routine and was not specifically foretold.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying he is dealing with false religion and will bring down temples, that this will be a sign, and points to a three hundred year old temple destroyed; the word is dated 3 July.
mentions.quote: I'm bringing those temples down
mentions.falsify_match: Earthquakes repeatedly destroy ancient non-Christian temples.
mentions.falsify_miss: Temple damage is no higher than background.

mentions.claim_text: He says Trump has two and a half years left if by grace he makes it, and hopes they do not throw the 25th amendment at him in the next seven months, or six at most now that August is here.
mentions.quote: they don't uh throw the 25th amendment at him in the next seven months
mentions.falsify_match: A 25th amendment move against Trump before the end of February 2027.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such move in that window.

mentions.claim_text: Reading a clip about God filling the earth with justice through the Mahdi, he says he told listeners they are pushing for the Mahdi and that this is what they will call the Antichrist when he arrives.
mentions.quote: that's what they call the Antichrist. When he comes on the scene
mentions.time_phrase: when he comes on the scene
mentions.falsify_match: A widely accepted Mahdi figure emerges.

mentions.claim_text: From his 2014 out-of-body tribulation experience he says the Antichrist will be called the Mahdi and will be a Muslim, and states his belief that it is Mohammed bin Salman because the man he saw looked just like him.
mentions.quote: I believe his he is MBS Muhammad bin Salam
mentions.falsify_match: Mohammed bin Salman takes a role matching the Antichrist description he gives.

mentions.claim_text: He warns listeners to get their hearts right because a shaking is coming to the nation, and repeats that God granted a reprieve window of time with Trump and asks what will be done with it; he says he saw into 2030 and mentions a courthouse.
mentions.quote: I'll give you a reprieve of a window of time
mentions.falsify_match: A period of relative calm under Trump followed by the shaking he describes.
mentions.falsify_miss: No reprieve, or no subsequent shaking.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying a socialist internet will try to take hold by 2030 and to watch what happens to the internet over the next three years.
mentions.quote: a socialist internet is going to try to take hold by 2030
mentions.falsify_match: State control of internet access or speech is established by 2030.

mentions.claim_text: He says Trump wants a reprieve and is the log in the road, that they are two and a half years in, that the Lord said to watch Judas, and that God protected Trump from assassination because there was more for him to do than a ballroom.
mentions.quote: the Lord said, "Watch Judas."
mentions.falsify_match: A close Trump ally betrays him publicly.

mentions.claim_text: He says the church's earlier prayer target was met because Trump was still in office before Usha Vance had her baby, and that the task now is to pray him across the finish line through the midterms, which the Lord said matter more than 2024 because of the governors and mayors.
mentions.quote: The Lord said midterms is more important than even 2024 was
mentions.falsify_match: The 2026 midterms prove more consequential than the 2024 presidential race.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip he says was posted 20 January 2025, over a year and almost two years earlier, and points at the new prime minister on screen saying he called it.
mentions.quote: There's the new prime minister. I said, "Watch it. He'll be
mentions.falsify_match: The clip names the leader before their rise.
mentions.falsify_miss: The clip is generic and the country is never specified.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that Turkey has taken a historic step on an energy alliance with Iraq worth a million barrels, and says this is the man with the five o'clock shadow he described before that man had even won his election, out of a word about three men and Iraq.
mentions.quote: it's the man with the 5:00 shadow, which it's getting thicker now
mentions.falsify_match: A Turkey-Iraq oil alliance at the stated scale, headed by the man he described.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such alliance or no match to the description.

mentions.claim_text: He instructs listeners to walk a Jericho march fifty yards outside their home, applying blood and anointing oil to the ground to seal a bloodline the enemy cannot cross.
mentions.quote: Go out 50 yards outside of your place of residence
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a devotional practice with no observable test.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He says some people think it will be later but he does not see how it could be, and introduces a word given back around January.
mentions.quote: some people think it'll be later, but I I don't see how it could be
mentions.falsify_match: The unnamed event arrives sooner than the later view expects.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying these elections matter as much as 2024 for what is coming over the next three years, and frames it around the next shmita cycle which ends in 2029 and the great awakening prayed for within it.
mentions.quote: The next shita cycle ends in 2029
mentions.falsify_match: A great awakening within the shmita cycle ending 2029.

mentions.claim_text: Reading that US special forces are on standby for a potential Iran nuclear material operation, he says he saw this back in February: a fence, men getting off a stealth helicopter, and groups of men.
mentions.quote: I saw them getting off of a uh a stealth hel helicopter
mentions.falsify_match: A US special forces raid on Iranian nuclear material.

mentions.claim_text: He says Iran has an untested and imperfect bomb held in a mountain that they do not want to waste and intend to use on Israel, and acknowledges it sounds like science fiction.
mentions.quote: They want to use it on Israel
mentions.falsify_match: Iran is confirmed to hold a nuclear device intended for use on Israel.

mentions.claim_text: He identifies a replayed clip as his 30 January vision of Trump building a golf course on Gaza.
mentions.quote: it's whenever I saw Trump building a golf course on the Gaza
mentions.falsify_match: A golf resort development on Gaza land.

mentions.claim_text: He says the mayors, Senate and House races matter but so does Europe, that the Lord is showing him a world war, and jokes about Kim posing as a spy on a mountain.
mentions.quote: the Lord is showing me even the World War
mentions.falsify_match: A general European war develops.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a Trump clip about the White House ballroom being very large, beautiful and safe, and a note that Senator Fetterman backed it after the attack.
mentions.quote: It's going to be very large and very beautiful and very safe
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a played clip with no claim of his own attached.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees him asking for more military aid next week, repeating that the request is for money and military aid.
mentions.quote: I see him asking for more military aid next week
mentions.falsify_match: A high-profile request for additional military aid in the week to 2 August 2026.

mentions.claim_text: Reviewing what he saw in the spirit about the weather on 17 July, he says plainly that it was not accurate everywhere he saw it and refuses to chalk it up as a hit.
mentions.quote: Is it everywhere I saw it? No. No
mentions.falsify_match: The 17 July weather word matched events in the places named.
mentions.falsify_miss: It did not, which he concedes here himself.

mentions.claim_text: He points to something earth-facing coming out of Italy that was forecast to arrive by 28 July, says the Lord warned about it on the 17th and that it happened today.
mentions.quote: it's earth facing and it's coming
mentions.falsify_match: An earth-facing solar or seismic event lands by 28 July 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He reads that the largest ever drone swarm attack on Russia happened today and that the US Selective Service System plans a computer simulation of a national mobilisation, which he says he did not like.
mentions.quote: plans a computer simulation to test how it would carry out a national mobilization
mentions.falsify_match: The Selective Service mobilisation exercise proceeds and a draft follows.
mentions.falsify_miss: The exercise is routine and no draft follows.

mentions.claim_text: He says a man he is watching is not done and he sees his face in Washington without knowing whether as a senator, asks prayer for Mike Lindell, and repeats that he sees Byron winning in the next week or two.
mentions.quote: I see Byron winning. Pray for Byron. It's next week or two weeks
mentions.falsify_match: Byron wins his primary within two weeks of 25 July 2026.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls saying they would try to assassinate him, notes the US is moving a large volume of assets into the Middle East and unloading in Saudi Arabia, and reads that an October 7th style attack was uncovered in Europe.
mentions.quote: they would try to assassinate him
mentions.falsify_match: An assassination attempt plus an October 7th style plot in Europe.

mentions.claim_text: Devotional prayer about following God's voice and not a stranger's, with the enemy as a roaring lion able to devour only those not filled with the Spirit.
mentions.quote: a stranger's voice I'll not follow
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: devotional prayer.
mentions.falsify_miss: unfalsifiable: no observable outcome is asserted.

mentions.claim_text: He introduces a replay of a vision he says he had on 7 July 2025 about what was happening in laboratories in certain cities.
mentions.quote: July the 7th of 2025, I had this vision
mentions.falsify_match: Human cloning work of the kind he describes is confirmed in named cities.

mentions.claim_text: He states he does not know when this happens or whether it is already underway, and says they intend to harvest organs, livers and kidneys from cloned people on the ground that they have no soul.
mentions.quote: they wanted to harvest their organs, their livers, their kidneys
mentions.condition_text: he explicitly declines to date it
mentions.falsify_match: Organ harvesting from cloned humans is documented.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such practice, though with no date this cannot expire.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are crossing human material with animal DNA to create demon-possessed super people, in labs in America, Japan and other parts of Asia, and notes the vision was over a year old before he saw anything match it.
mentions.quote: they will create super people that was completely demonp possessed
mentions.falsify_match: Human-animal hybrid research producing viable beings is confirmed.

mentions.claim_text: He reports the Lord saying they will poke a giant called the church in the days ahead, notes a particular church they wanted to convert into a mosque, and shows a map of English churches now operating as mosques with green dots for those opened in 2026.
mentions.quote: they will poke uh uh the a big giant called the church
mentions.falsify_match: Continued conversion of church buildings into mosques and a church backlash.
mentions.falsify_miss: Conversions stop or no backlash follows.

mentions.claim_text: He notes a meeting in America on 24 September focused on the AI race, quotes Trump saying whoever wins that race probably wins outright, and says he saw it was a major race.
mentions.quote: I saw it was a major race
mentions.falsify_match: A major AI summit in America on 24 September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such meeting on that date.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls a February word to pray for special operations troops whose lives were in danger, says he saw three major places, and connects it to the current standby reporting.
mentions.quote: Pray for these men for their lives in danger
mentions.falsify_match: A three-site special forces operation with casualties.

mentions.claim_text: He says the direction of everything will be known by the midterms within four months, counting August, September, October and the first week of November.
mentions.quote: you'll know the direction of how everything will go by midterm
mentions.falsify_match: The November 2026 result visibly settles the direction he describes.

mentions.claim_text: Responding to viewers expecting a total red wave, he says he prays they are right and that he is completely off, and invites them to stop watching him if a red wave bigger than 2024 arrives.
mentions.quote: I pray I'm completely off my off of it
mentions.falsify_match: The 2026 midterms fall short of a red wave, matching his doubt.
mentions.falsify_miss: A red wave larger than 2024, which he says would discredit him.

mentions.claim_text: He says days of great fun have begun for the remnant, references the shaking of Jeremiah 24, and says he will watch from the cleft of the rock as the death angel passes rather than take part in it.
mentions.quote: Days of great fun have just begun
mentions.falsify_match: A visible split where the remnant prospers while the wider shaking runs.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is moved by the word of God rather than what he sees, that the stock market may crash around them but he will not participate in it, and notes he holds no stock.
mentions.quote: The stock market may crash around us, but I'm not participating
mentions.falsify_match: A stock market crash from which his audience is insulated.
